integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard definitions and the exact unit-ball/unit-polydisc Kobayashi-Eisenman values. The Caratheodory-Eisenman upper bound follows from a line Schwarz contraction, phase averaging, Hadamard's inequality, and a one-variable AM-GM optimization; the bound is attained by an explicit linear map. No numerical approximation or finite enumeration is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the mixed-product invariants at the origin and does not assert a new boundary asymptotic for general domains. It does not give an explicit all-point formula, although the factors are homogeneous. Classical invariant-volume literature is extensive, so an older equivalent product computation under different notation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Eisenman quotient on polydisc–ball product models
